title: Profile Bank
description: Single source of truth for all agent claims about a candidate's career and background, PLUS every person-specific CV/cover-letter/verifier/humanizer rule the modes-rb/* prompts used to hardcode. Task 2.2 rewrites the modes to be person-agnostic and read all of this from here. New keys added in schema v3 (candidate.file_slug/tagline, rules.bullet_counts/space_fill/education_display/extras/section_headings/language_level_labels/classification_defs/address_lookup, top-level humanize + verify) are OPTIONAL for backward compatibility with pre-v3 instances.

file_slug.description: Output filename base. Used for all generated artefacts: '{file_slug}_CV.tex', '{file_slug}_cover-letter.tex', and their PDFs. Replaces the hardcoded 'Firstname-Lastname' in every mode/script.

tagline.description: Sidebar tagline config. The tagline itself is generated per-role from the JD, but its formatting constraints are template-fixed personal data.

default.description: Fallback positioning line when no role-tailored tagline is generated. May be empty string for candidates who always tailor.

max_chars_per_line.description: Hard character cap per tagline line for this candidate's CV template column width (rb-lm: 58mm at \large\textbf holds ~22 chars before wrapping).

city.description: City component of the address, used for apply-form 'city' fields.

zip.description: Postal code component, used for apply-form 'zip/postal' fields.

country.description: Country component, used for apply-form 'country' fields.

work_authorization.description: Verbatim answer for apply-form work authorization / right-to-work / visa fields (e.g. 'Swiss citizen, full right to work, no sponsorship required').

title_localized.description: Per-language rendered job title for the CV/CL experience-block header, keyed by JD language code (en/de/fr). When present, the writer uses title_localized[<jd_lang>] instead of `role`; falls back to `role` when the language is absent. Prevents an English title (e.g. 'Engineer Intern') leaking into a non-English CV.

end_status.description: completed: role finished. current_indefinite: still in role, no end date set. contract_ending: still in role but with a known end date (used for tense rules).

surface_in.description: Which JD classifications this achievement should be surfaced for.

confidence.description: high: exact wording from real source. medium: summarized, needs care.

skills_master.description: Skills bank, tagged by category, for the writer to select from.

never_mention.description: Terms that must never appear in any output (e.g. 'VBA').

departure_date.description: Contract end date of the most recent role. Roles ending on/after today use present tense; roles ending before use past tense.

bullet_counts.description: Per-experience-block bullet allocation rules for the CV writer (write-cv Step 3). One entry per experience block that has a fixed count rule.

default.description: Default bullet count for this block.

default_max.description: Upper bound when a range is allowed (e.g. PwC 4-5 -> default 5, default_max 5, floor via reduce).

reduce_to.description: Reduced bullet count when reduce_when fires.

reduce_when.description: Condition (referencing classification_defs where possible) that triggers reduce_to.

always_include.description: true = block is mandatory in every CV.

classification_note.description: Human-readable disambiguation the writer must state explicitly.

classification_defs.description: Reusable classification definitions referenced by bullet_counts.reduce_when and space_fill conditions.

space_fill.description: Single-page space-fill logic as data (write-cv Step 3 space-fill + Step 9). base_formula documents how base_count is summed; optional_blocks are the Chopard/Prepa-style conditional inclusions.

fill_threshold.description: base_count threshold below which the last optional education block is pulled in.

block.description: education or experience id to conditionally add.

condition.description: Inclusion condition expressed against classification + base_count.

absolute.description: true = condition is the ONLY gate; space-fill must never override it (Chopard).

education_display.description: Education display rules (write-cv Step 3 education + write-cl hard rule 7 + humanize 5a).

cgpa_institution.description: education id the CGPA belongs to.

cgpa_must_open_mba_bullet.description: true = the degree's CV bullet must OPEN with the CGPA figure.

mba_cv_bullet_canonical.description: Canonical full text of the flagship-degree CV bullet.

mba_required_tokens.description: Substrings the verifier requires in the degree bullet (e.g. ['5.5','LAW']).

prepa_cv_bullet_canonical.description: Canonical text for the conditional prep-school education bullet.

min_education_bullet_chars.description: Minimum rendered chars for any education bullet.

extras.description: Conditional extra-curricular / sidebar items (write-cv Step 5). Order is priority order for space-filling.

condition.description: 'always', a classification predicate, or a space-fill predicate. May reference conditional_mentions.

section_headings.description: Per-language section-heading labels for the CV template (write-cv Step 5). Keyed by logical section; each value maps CV language code (en/de/fr) to the exact heading string. Cover EVERY heading the template renders: professional_experience, education, foreign_languages, personal_skills, computer_skills, extracurricular, contact_details (the last overrides the template's hardcoded \sidebarSection{CONTACT DETAILS}). 'extracurricular_banned' lists per-language strings the heading must never be.

language_level_labels.description: CV FOREIGN LANGUAGES sidebar labels (write-cv Step 5). Keyed by CV/JD language code (en/de/fr); each maps CEFR/native levels to the display label in that language.

address_lookup.description: Company-address resolution config (write-cl Step 5 + notion-entry Step 2). The lookup PROCEDURE stays generic in the mode; the registry domains and city-centre zip fallbacks are market-specific personal data.

registry_domains.description: Ordered authoritative registries to search (e.g. zefix.ch, local.ch).

city_centre_zips.description: Fallback postal codes by city when no street address is found.

humanize.description: Person/house-style banned vocabulary for the humanizer + writers (humanize.md job-application bans, write-cl Banned phrases, framing banned_words/banned_bullet_openers). The 29 generic blader/humanizer patterns stay in the mode; only the concrete word/phrase LISTS live here.

banned_words.description: Words banned anywhere in output (any language-neutral / English).

banned_bullet_openers.description: Words no bullet or sentence may open with.

banned_phrases.description: English banned phrases / constructions (cover-letter clichés + AI patterns).

verify.description: Verifier hard rules as data (verify.md standing rules + write-cv/write-cl hard rules). The verifier's quote-verification PROCEDURE and SUPPORTED/INFERRED classification stay generic in the mode; the person-specific blockers and numeric tolerances live here.

check.description: Concrete, mechanical check the verifier runs (what string/condition to look for and where).

tolerances.description: Numeric gates. cv_min_fill_pct/cv_max_pages drive cv_fitcheck.py; word/line counts drive the writers.
